title: 258 Albert St (Z-25-27)
body:
Holding Removal - 258 Albert St
The property owner is requesting to lift the (H) holding provision in relation to the property at 258 Albert Street. Zoning By-law Amendment Z-25-27 will lift the holding provision on the lands. There are no other changes proposed to the zoning by-law with this application.
The property has an on-going site plan application for a 3-storey residential building containing 21 bedrooms and 1 accessible parking space.
This application is intended to proceed through delegated authority pursuant to City of Waterloo By-law No. 2023-073, which provides the City’s Director of Planning decision making authority for zoning amendments that are deemed to be minor in nature. A public meeting will not be held unless the Director of Planning refers this application to Council.
View the documents submitted by the development company under supporting documents on this page for more details and drawings.
You can provide feedback to the planning department, and it will be shared with the delegated staff authority, or ask a question to learn more about this application by contacting the planner.
Images are provided by the applicant and may not reflect the final design approved by the planning division.
